brand.name: AiCodingAgentTeam
brand.tagline: A Golang-based AI coding orchestration platform.

hero.title: Coordinate a 9-role software team with AI coding CLIs.
hero.subtitle: AiCodingAgentTeam is a Go-based orchestrator that dispatches Codex, OpenCode, Claude-Code and DeepSeek-DSH — without holding any API key — to build, review, and ship code under a deterministic quality gate.

home.footerNote: Released under the MIT License · Static export deployed via GitHub Pages

features.title: Core features
features.subtitle: Everything you need to orchestrate AI coding without giving up control.

separation.title: Orchestration vs execution
separation.body: The Coordinator orchestrates and never writes code. Host CLIs execute and never decide. No coupling, no blurred responsibility.

containerRoles.title: Container-as-role
containerRoles.body: 9 team roles — PM, Architect, Frontend, Backend, QA, Security, DevOps — each in its own container, independently scalable and replaceable.

a2a.title: A2A protocol collaboration
a2a.body: Structured inter-agent messaging. InProc mode for development, Redis Pub/Sub for containerized deployment.

quality.title: Deterministic quality gate
quality.body: golangci-lint, go vet and go test run as a hard machine check. No relying on the model to grade itself.

rag.title: RAG + project memory
rag.body: BM25 retrieval injects context. Memory accumulates failure lessons and historical solutions across runs.

protocols.title: Four external protocols
protocols.body: gRPC for the TUI, MCP for external tools, ACP for standard Agent clients, A2A for cross-instance mesh.

local.title: Local-first, keyless
local.body: Code stays inside the container. No API keys held. All authentication is delegated to the underlying host CLI.

architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.subtitle: A five-layer flow: route → plan → schedule → execute → verify.

layers.router: Intent router classifies the user's request and chooses the workflow.
layers.planner: Planner builds a DAG of writer and reviewer nodes.
layers.scheduler: Scheduler dispatches reviewer nodes in parallel; writer nodes serially under a single-writer lock.
layers.knowledge: Knowledge (BM25 RAG) and Memory inject relevant context into each node.
layers.qualityGate: Quality gate runs machine-checkable verifications; failures surface with structured detail.

quickstart.title: Quick Start
quickstart.subtitle: Single-binary mode is the fastest path; TUI and containers are optional layers.

build.title: 1. Build the binary
build.body: Compile from source — pure Go, no runtime dependencies.

init.title: 2. Initialize a project
init.body: Scaffold the workspace configuration in the current directory.

run.title: 3. Run a full pipeline
run.body: Pass a natural-language requirement and pick a backend (Codex is the real driver).

verify.title: 4. Verify quality
verify.body: Run the deterministic quality gate on the artifacts produced.
